offering_description.value: Owns, develops, leases and manages office properties, renting workspace to corporate, professional services, life science and government tenants in the Philadelphia, Austin and Washington DC markets. It earns rent from long-term leases and fees for managing buildings.

customer_segment.value: B2B: corporate office tenants, professional services firms, life science and technology companies; B2G: federal and state government agency tenants

end_markets.value: office real estate; professional services; life sciences; technology; government

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: office rent paid by tenants under long-term leases; service fees: property management and leasing fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs office buildings, leasing space to business and government tenants; service provider: manages buildings and leasing for its own properties and tenants

geography_served.value: US regional: Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, Virginia, Maryland, Texas

specialization.value: niche specialist: office properties and their leasing and management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house leasing teams negotiating directly with tenants; agents / brokers: commercial real estate brokers representing tenants

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: REIT tax rules, SEC reporting, and local zoning and environmental rules
